milestones.title: Taxonomy, baseline + LLM extraction, trend views, stats endpoints
evidence: Taxonomy: config/skills.yaml (336 skills, 10 role families) with a validating loader; duplicate ids/aliases rejected.
Baseline: deterministic word-boundary alias matcher with negation, nice-to-have required flags and multilingual normalisation.

LLM: provider-agnostic structured extractor with taxonomy validation, once-only JSON retry and prompt-injection isolation; the real OpenAI-compatible adapter (providers.py) is gated off by default, key only from SKILLPULSE_LLM_API_KEY, and fails closed without a shared atomic Redis daily budget; on failure the service stores the baseline flagged as fallback (offline baseline always usable).
Persistence: migration 0002 adds post_extractions, post_skills, skill_trend_mv and skill_segment_mv (unique indexes for CONCURRENTLY refresh; 3-state remote_state so remote=false excludes unknown).

Trends: exact numerator/denominator per month and segment; total_posts is eligible posts for the requested extractor/taxonomy (not full-source coverage, which /v1/coverage reports); shares withheld below 30 posts.
Stats API on FastAPI: /healthz, /readyz, /v1/skills/top, /v1/skills/{id}/trend, /v1/coverage.
Labelled synthetic set of 40 posts (eval/datasets/synthetic_extraction.json); baseline micro-F1 0.9910 / macro-F1 0.9783 recorded in eval/results/baseline_synthetic.json (synthetic, not real data).
Integration tests run the real Postgres 16 migration, the CONCURRENTLY refresh and the real endpoints.

worker-skills is wired: skillpulse workers/skills run bounded, idempotent extraction batches via the default-closed provider factory and the shared Redis budget, and a nightly beat task refreshes the trend views in AUTOCOMMIT.
remaining_gates: Real-LLM F1 (S2 >= 0.85) and the real-HN labelled set (~150 posts) are BLOCKED: the LLM gate is off and no provider credential/base URL is configured, and labelling real HN post text needs the M1 authorization gate.
The baseline-vs-LLM table cannot be completed until both real runs exist; the synthetic baseline F1 is not a real-data S2 result.
milestones.spec_acceptance: Extraction set labelled: synthetic set done, real-HN set NOT done. Baseline vs LLM F1 recorded (S2): baseline on synthetic recorded, real LLM F1 NOT recorded.

milestones.title: Tools module, LangGraph agent, grounding check, /v1/ask, fixture DB, agent eval
evidence: skillpulse.tools: the five read-only tools (search_jobs, skill_counts, skill_trend, compare_skills, match_cv) with typed bounded Pydantic arguments, fixed parameterized SQL (no model-written SQL and no raw-SQL escape hatch), content-addressed result_id values, eligible-post denominator semantics, 3-state remote and the <30-post share suppression.

Read-only tool sessions set READ ONLY/PRAGMA query_only plus a statement timeout and row cap; migration 0003 adds the NOLOGIN skillpulse_readonly Postgres role with SELECT only (no embedded credential).

LangGraph agent (plan -> tools -> draft -> grounding check) with max 6 tool calls, one rewrite and a wall-clock deadline; a configurable OpenAI-compatible model path reuses the M3 client and the shared Redis budget and is off by default.
Grounding fails closed on fabricated citations and only typed share/rate fields prove a percent; structured claims are validated against the exact field path and rendered from it.
POST /v1/ask streams SSE plan/tool_call/tool_result/token/done(trace_id,partial,grounded)/error, cancels on disconnect, returns 503 for Postgres down and never returns internal errors or credentials.

Deterministic SQLite fixture DB (no post text) and eval/datasets/agent_cases.json (9 behaviour cases: grounded statistics, ambiguity, impossible Greek, injection, invented numbers, tool failure, cancellation); fake-model fixture result 9/9 correct, grounding 1.0, tool selection 1.0 recorded in eval/results/agent_fixture_fake.json.

Canonical five-year synthetic evaluation fixture (src/skillpulse/eval/synthetic_fixture.py): 2019-2023, 60 months, 1800 metadata-only posts (synthetic ids/companies, role/remote/region/skills, no post text or PII), a fixed fixture version and a SHA-256 semantic row hash stable across Windows/Linux/SQLite, separate from the tiny smoke fixture so its counts cannot drift.

Canonical agent set eval/datasets/agent_eval_cases.json (64 questions, 222 expected facts) generated by src/skillpulse/eval/agent_dataset.py; expected_facts are computed by independent SQL over the raw fixture tables (not by the tools under test), cover all five tools and all SPEC section 11 categories (top-N, trend, comparison, role/region/remote incl. unknown != false, CV gap, ambiguity, out-of-scope, impossible/rare-country, injection, adversarial, undersampled <30, robustness), and the committed JSON is regenerated and compared byte-for-byte by tests.

Region filter implemented in search_jobs (SPEC section 9): a bounded country argument matched against the extracted country list, returned per row; a genuine month_to bug was found and fixed (a date bound dropped December on SQLite) with regression coverage, and the deterministic fake planner now drives search_jobs, role/remote/region filters and explicit-year windows so all five tools and all categories are exercised.

Contract runner (src/skillpulse/eval/agent_eval.py) checks expected facts against the exact tool-result fields and reports correctness, grounding, tool selection, facts passed, mean steps, p95 latency and provider usage (null with a reason for the fake model); the synthetic run is tagged model=fake/source=synthetic_fixture/acceptance=not_real_acceptance in eval/results/agent_fixture_synthetic.json, and tests/test_agent_eval_synthetic.py adds a 2-question regression gate (eval/baseline_agent.json per SPEC section 13) plus failure-sensitive controls (changed tool count, forged citation, count-cannot-prove-percent, unsupported number, below-30 suppression) that fail as required and are restored.
remaining_gates: Real-model S3 (answer correctness >= 0.85) and S4 (grounding >= 0.98) need SKILLPULSE_AGENT_LLM_ENABLED with an OpenAI-compatible base URL/model and a shared Redis budget; none supplied, so only the fake-model fixture run exists and it is not a real-model number.
Hosted /v1/ask and the MCP client checks (S8) need the M5/M6 deployment.
milestones.spec_acceptance: Agent set: dataset/harness delivered (64 questions, 222 expected facts, frozen five-year synthetic fixture, all five tools, all categories); the fake-model contract run is correctness 1.0, grounding 1.0, facts 222/222 and is explicitly not_real_acceptance. S3 (correctness >= 0.85) and S4 (grounding >= 0.98) with a real model: NOT met (no credential/budget supplied).

milestones.title: MCP server (stdio + HTTP)
evidence: skillpulse.mcp_server (official mcp==2.3.0 SDK, MCPServer) exposes the same five M4 read-only tools over stdio and streamable HTTP; every call goes through the shared ToolRuntime, registry, read-only session, bounds and result_id, with no MCP-only query path and no SQL/filesystem/shell tool.

Typed bounded arguments are mirrored in the MCP inputSchema (verified against the shared Pydantic models); skillpulse://taxonomy is a read-only resource; errors are sanitised to safe tool errors (ToolInputError/validation text, 'database unavailable', generic fallback) and the DB DSN is never returned.

HTTP defaults to loopback with DNS-rebinding protection on, bad Host -> 421 and bad Origin -> 403, and a non-loopback bind is refused unless SKILLPULSE_MCP_ALLOW_NON_LOOPBACK=true; stdio keeps stdout protocol-only and logs to stderr; the engine/ToolRuntime live on a lifespan and are disposed on shutdown.

Real protocol tests: tests/test_m5_mcp_protocol.py drives the real SDK client over stdio and an HTTP subprocess, with negative controls (unknown tool, bad args, oversized cv_text, unknown skill), a DB-failure safety check, schema/model parity, a raw-write denial proving read-only, and process-tree teardown on Windows.

Real MCP Inspector CLI roundtrip (@modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2.11.0, Node v24.11.1, npx 11.6.2): tools/list over stdio and HTTP and tools/call skill_counts top_n=2 over stdio, tests/test_m5_inspector.py (env-gated SKILLPULSE_RUN_INSPECTOR=1), evidence in docs/evidence/.

Fixed a latent M4 bug found by M5: search_jobs with no filters built invalid SQL ('... AND  ORDER BY'); regression test tests/test_m4_tools_agent.py::test_search_jobs_without_filters_returns_rows added.
Suite: 154 passed, 3 skipped (env-gated Inspector) in 62 s; ruff clean; strict mypy clean (43 files); negative control (SQLite query_only guard removed) failed as required, then restored green.
remaining_gates: Claude Desktop end-to-end (S8 'works in Claude Desktop'): BLOCKED - needs the GUI and a global client-config edit; not validated this round. Ready example config + manual check are in docs/m5-acceptance.md and docs/claude-desktop-mcp.example.json.
Web (GUI) MCP Inspector and the demo GIF: not run/produced (need a browser/GUI); only the pinned CLI was used. No GIF is shipped and none is faked (M7 owns the GIF).
Hosted/public MCP endpoint remains unverified. Local M6 Kubernetes smoke exercises the actual MCP HTTP service through a temporary loopback port-forward; that is not public hosting evidence.
milestones.spec_acceptance: MCP server (stdio + HTTP) exposing the same read-only tools: delivered and green (real SDK + Inspector CLI). Works in MCP Inspector: CLI roundtrip met; GUI not claimed. Works in Claude Desktop (S8): BLOCKED, not validated (recorded with a ready config + manual check).

Terraform init/fmt/validate pass. A fresh isolated k3d deployment using values-ci.yaml completed in 222 seconds (3m42s), including synthetic PostgreSQL/MCP smoke, real reader privilege checks and API/MCP metrics assertions. All eight pods remained ready with zero restarts at the follow-up check. Tools and image/build caches already existed; cold-machine startup is not claimed.

make up/down/secrets/smoke call actual guarded shell commands, not placeholders. Secrets and kubeconfig stay outside version control and Terraform state. Live HN, both model gates and Langfuse stay disabled.

deploy-check.yml performs chart/schema/Terraform checks and actual isolated deployment plus synthetic PostgreSQL/MCP smoke. It enforces a 20-minute step deadline and strict less-than-1200s successful deployment/smoke, uploads revision/timing/outcome/log artifacts, and cleans the isolated cluster/registry/state. Five deterministic policy cases pass; an inclusive-1200s mutation fails. All workflows pass actionlint. PR #1 deployment run 38870868739 passed on a fresh GitHub-hosted runner in 166 seconds; its downloaded evidence records successful smoke, no configured application cache and tested PR merge revision e58972c3ee6a2ef603a1dfe1e1efe1f4d3e38229. See docs/deployment.md and the branch log for general-CI fixes and exact tested revisions.

CloudNativePG manages separate API/MCP logins and password Secrets; workers and migrations keep the owner connection. Post-migration SQL grants read-only membership. A temporary UPDATE grant correctly fails the smoke; revoking it restores a passing run.
remaining_gates: Full PR CI success on the corrected revision and green main (S7). The first PR deployment-check passed; it does not establish a main run.
Production hosting, credential lifecycle, endpoint exposure and rollout review remain outside this local deployment; separate API/MCP read-only logins are implemented and locally permission-tested.
milestones.spec_acceptance: Fresh local-cluster startup and end-to-end synthetic/security/metrics smoke pass in 3m42s with preinstalled tools and existing caches. A separate fresh GitHub-hosted PR deployment/smoke passed in 166 seconds (run 38870868739); downloaded evidence names the tested PR merge revision. S1 has local and fresh-hosted evidence. milestones.title: Metrics, Langfuse, release.yml, README polish, demo GIF, CV line
evidence: Actual /metrics endpoint counts requests with bounded method/route-template/status labels and records API agent counts/duration. Unknown paths and query strings do not become labels.

Optional metadata-only Langfuse OTLP/HTTP exporter is wired into API agent execution. Disabled/incomplete configuration makes no request; failures are sanitized and nonfatal. No prompts, CVs, answers or tool payloads are exported.

Eleven observability/MCP tests pass, including real HTTP tool counter increments, safe failures, bounded labels, cross-connection persisted extraction counts and NaN on count failure. Latest full suite: 182 passed, 5 opt-in skipped, including all 19 Docker integration tests; three opt-in Inspector CLI tests and two opt-in real Langfuse tests pass separately.

MCP HTTP exposes its own /metrics for handler count/duration; API scrapes committed post_extractions counts for baseline/llm with a one-second PostgreSQL timeout, not misleading worker-local counters. Synthetic Kubernetes smoke validates the stored row gauge and a one-call MCP counter increase.

Offline acceptance preflight checks configuration presence without network requests or gate activation. Fourteen PowerShell assertions cover missing/configured fixtures, process-environment precedence, secret redaction, placeholders, HN authorization and strict failure. Removing the placeholder filter in a disposable copy correctly fails the tests. CI runs these fixture tests.

release.yml validates tags, runs quality checks, packages Helm and publishes GHCR images on approved v* tags. actionlint passes and rejects a deliberately invalid control. Feature branch and PR #1 were published with approval; no release tag or external image publication was performed; local real-backend Langfuse ingestion/read-back is separately verified.
README and docs/deployment.md describe commands, privacy limits and acceptance gates; the runbook includes a claim-limited CV line.

Native Cline free-model agents produced bounded workflow/stack drafts; parent independently corrected and verified them. Explicit CLI providers/models and isolated state were used; no paid fallback. Probes and the completed M6 run report zero cost; incomplete M7/runner attempts are not counted as successful tasks.

Real local Langfuse smoke passed two executed tests: exact trace/span ID read-back, private visibility, typed metadata, no synthetic prompt/CV/answer/error sentinel or input/output payload, and disabled export making no HTTP attempt or stored trace. Final full stack/test/cleanup run exited 0 in 53.3s with cached images. Compose images are digest-pinned, only loopback web is published, project names are unique and all own containers/volumes/networks were independently confirmed removed.

PowerShell runner parses and rejects occupied ports before starting services; JUnit guards reject zero tests, all-skipped, failures and missing cases. A deliberate enabled-export mutation fails the disabled-send assertion. Default pytest skips live tests without network and explicit opt-in rejects non-loopback URLs. No hosted tracing endpoint result is inferred.
remaining_gates: Demo GIF and Claude Desktop GUI evidence (S8), which are not fabricated.
Remote release workflow run after explicit publication approval, producing the reviewed release tag and GHCR images.
milestones.spec_acceptance: API/MCP metrics, persisted extraction volume, privacy-safe exporter, real local Langfuse ingestion/read-back, prerequisite checks, workflows and runbooks delivered.
